deployments_detail.use: "SCRAIS" AI inspection brand for wafer/PCB (high precision, low false positives, Jun 2024) + "SARIA" image-processing AI dev tool

SCRAIS brand for AI-driven defect inspection/measurement of semiconductor wafers and printed circuit boards; deep-learning false-call filtering and auto defect classification built into SCREEN inspection equipment. Validated to eliminate over 80% of false calls and hold oversight rate below 0.1%, refined over ~7 years on SCREEN group inspection tools. [SCREEN (proprietary deep learning)]
deployments_detail.value: >80% false-call reduction; oversight rate <0.1%; ~50% annotation labor reduction

deployments_detail.use: SCRAIS AI image-analysis solution productized by SCREEN Advanced System Solutions, extending its deep-learning defect-detection/anomaly-monitoring beyond semiconductor to film/sheet web inspection, surveillance and food inspection, with AI-model learning and operational phases supported end to end. [SCREEN Advanced System Solutions (proprietary deep learning)]
deployments_detail.value: >80% false-call reduction; oversight rate <0.1%; ~50% annotation reduction

deployments_detail.use: Three-year joint development with AI firm Rist of a 'next-generation AI inspection model' for semiconductor wafers and PCBs, combining SCREEN AS inspection-AI data/know-how (patent-pending method reaching high accuracy with half the usual training data) with Rist's AI engineering and knowledge-distillation to run large high-precision models on the factory floor with minimal tuning. [Rist (AI engineering); SCREEN Advanced System Solutions]
deployments_detail.value: half the conventional training data volume for target accuracy

deployments_detail.use: Capital and business alliance with AI venture Laboro.AI (SCREEN AS took an equity stake) to jointly plan, develop and deploy AI applications across SCREEN Group semiconductor-manufacturing equipment and solutions, both for internal group operations and external offerings. [Laboro.AI]

Cell3iMager NX life-science cell imager offers an optional deep-learning plug-in for highly accurate cell segmentation in challenging cases (high-confluency, non-uniform or overlapping cells), used for label-free organoid proliferation monitoring and cancer-spheroid/NK-cell assay quantification. [SCREEN Holdings (Life Science) proprietary deep learning]

SU-3400 single-wafer cleaning equipment uses IoT/big-data failure detection plus high-resolution in-chamber camera monitoring for stable operation and trouble prevention, integrated into support/maintenance functions. [SCREEN Semiconductor Solutions]

SARIA all-round no-code image-AI software: lets users build, evaluate and analyze image-processing/recognition AI models, from beginner no-code up to source-editable neural networks, with annotation support and planned knowledge-distillation and Human-in-the-Loop features. Released commercially August 2024. [SCREEN Advanced System Solutions]

'Real Shugo Talk' (りある守護とーく) generative-AI knowledge system for manufacturers: securely surfaces internal design data, manufacturing know-how and after-sales info with permission-based sensitive-information masking; used for field-engineer support, knowledge transfer/training and recipe documentation. [SCREEN Advanced System Solutions (generative AI)]
